authority: ONE BRAIN canonical tenant-scoped customer input
root_cause: First CSV/XLSX import recorded only raw cells, column labels and file provenance, not what the dataset represents, how one row is interpreted, its use/purpose, intended module or reviewed column roles. Consumers could see a table without reliable business meaning.
prevention: Before any write, generate explainable bounded category, target area, grain, purpose, field roles, period and quality from column names and table contents; require tenant-user explicit review; hard block highly restricted fields and require lawful-processing confirmation for person data. Never silently mutate KPI metrics, import through a second store or infer a completed automated action.

production_readback: NOT_VERIFIED: protected merge and same-sha Netlify production plus signed-in import readback of semantic context and named Brain consumer ACK required

evidence.prechange: Initial 2026-11-22 Portal V2 CSV/XLSX import saved fileName, sheet, columns, rows, fingerprint and general provenance but no explicit verified business purpose or destination.

limits: Existing import limits retained: 4MB, 1000 rows, 40 columns, 220KB per table, 450KB combined.
releaseGates: authenticated tenant upload + independent semantic readback
